description: This file defines a migration class for a database schema update in the OrangeHRM system, specifically targeting the 'hs_hr_emp_member_detail' table to modify its primary key and constraints.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class responsible for handling database schema migration for version 4.1.1 of OrangeHRM, including modifications to the 'hs_hr_emp_member_detail' table such as dropping foreign keys, altering primary keys, and adding columns.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the schema changes for upgrading the database to version 4.1.1, including disabling constraints, dropping foreign keys, modifying the primary key, adding a new 'id' column with auto-increment, and re-enabling constraints.
